title: Tighter PRF-Security Bound for TBC-MAC
summary: A PRF-security bound is established for TBC-MAC, while obtaining a tighter bound, potentially using techniques attributed to Bellare et al., remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: TBC-MAC has an established PRF-security bound for an adversary making $q$ queries, with each query containing at most $\ell$ blocks of $n$ bits. The unresolved task is to derive a tighter PRF-security bound for TBC-MAC under these parameters, potentially by applying the techniques attributed to Bellare et al. in the discussion of the existing bound.

scope.domain: PRF-security bounds for the TBC-MAC construction.
assumptions: The adversary makes q queries, each containing at most ell blocks of n bits.
parameters: ell: maximum number of blocks in each query
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive a tighter PRF-security bound for TBC-MAC under these parameters, potentially using the techniques attributed to Bellare et al.

citations.label: Tweakable Blockciphers with Beyond Birthday-Bound Security

progress.summary: After stating a PRF-security theorem for TBC-MAC, the source notes that a tighter bound could be achieved with more work by following techniques attributed to Bellare et al.
citation_labels: Will Landecker et al., Tweakable Blockciphers with Beyond Birthday-Bound Security
